subject: The one friend who still has ads
preview_text: You know who I mean. The one who keeps complaining about interruptions. This fixes it.

They don't need a better phone or better headphones. They need a quieter app. Same boost, zero interruptions. No notifications, no popups, no noise.
Volume Booster Pro does exactly that. The same engine you use, but stripped down to the slider and nothing else. It auto-applies when they plug in, then disappears. No bloat, no monetization theater.
Send them this email. One tap, and they'll see what you already know: the slider, the calm, and nothing else. P.S. They'll thank you after their next podcast.
